selectionNote: Selected after visually comparing 11 Commons candidates and 35 Flickr candidates. This precise Jiaju view has sharp architecture, multiple houses across the hillside, a legible winding path, and no dominant rooftop appliance foreground. It outranks newer but soft autumn phone images. No October 2026 capture date or autumn color claim is made.
